name: aggregate.zoo
title: Compute Summary Statistics of zoo Objects

origin.description: Split a zoo series into groups and return one summary per group.
origin.usage: aggregate(x, by, FUN = sum, ..., regular = NULL, frequency = NULL, coredata = TRUE)

arguments.name: by
arguments.text: A vector of the same length as the index, defining the groups and the new index, or a function applied to the index.

arguments.name: FUN
arguments.text: Summary applied to each group. It must return a fixed length. The default is sum.
Further arguments passed to FUN, such as na.rm.

arguments.name: regular
arguments.text: Whether the result is a regular zooreg series. The default follows the class of x.

arguments.name: frequency
arguments.text: Frequency of a regular result. Supplying it forces regular to TRUE.

arguments.name: coredata
arguments.text: If TRUE, FUN sees the values in the group. If FALSE, FUN sees the zoo series for the group.

origin.details: Groups follow the first occurrence of each value of by, and the result is stored in index order. The default summary is the sum. For values 1, NA, 3 grouped by 1, 1, 2, sum with na.rm TRUE returns 1 and 3 at indexes 1 and 2.
origin.value: A zoo series, or a zooreg series when regular is TRUE.

translation.description: Split a zoo series into groups and return one summary per group.
translation.usage: aggregate_zoo(x, by, fun=None, regular=None, frequency=None, coredata=True, **kwargs)

arguments.name: by
arguments.text: A vector of the same length as the index, defining the groups and the new index, or a function applied to the index.

arguments.name: fun
arguments.text: Summary applied to each group. The default is the sum, which returns missing when a group contains a missing value unless na_rm is true.

arguments.name: regular
arguments.text: Whether the result is regular. The default follows the series.

arguments.name: frequency
arguments.text: Frequency of a regular result. Supplying it forces regular to true.

arguments.name: coredata
arguments.text: If True, fun sees the values in the group. If False, fun sees the zoo series for the group.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: Passed to the summary. For the default sum, true drops missing values before adding.

translation.details: Groups follow the first occurrence of each value of by, and the result is stored in index order. For values 1, NA, 3 grouped by 1, 1, 2, the sum with na_rm true returns 1 and 3 at indexes 1 and 2.
translation.value: A Zoo series, marked regular when regular is true.
translation.example:
import math
import sys

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/zoo")
from zoo.zoo_class import aggregate_zoo, ifelse_zoo, is_zoo, median_zoo, quantile_zoo, rev_zoo, xtfrm_zoo, zoo


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, (bool, np.bool_)):
        print("TRUE" if value else "FALSE")
        return
    if is_zoo(value):
        show(value.data)
        show(value.index)
        return
    array = np.asarray(value, dtype=float).ravel(order="F")
    print(" ".join("NA" if math.isnan(float(item)) else format(float(item), ".16g") for item in array))

show(aggregate_zoo(zoo([1, float('nan'), 3], [1, 2, 3]), [1, 1, 2], na_rm=True))
